routes.label: 4 Av-9 St → 14 St-8 Av (F to W 4 St, then A/C/E)
routes.top: F and A/C/E lateness at W 4 St-Wash Sq move together (Spearman +0.26, p=0.000, 798 bins). Both lines are disrupted (mean lateness ≥4 min) in the same 15 min 2.1× more often than chance.
routes.dominant: wait for the F at 4 Av-9 St

routes.label: 4 Av-9 St → 14 St-8 Av (F to Jay St, cross-platform to A/C)
routes.top: A trains that would reach Jay St-MetroTech within 180 s behind a C in the evening/night lose 293 s more there than free-running A trains (95% CI 6–854 s, p=0.039); 24% of A trips are in that situation, and when that C is itself ≥3 min late the loss is 320 s; across 2 shared stops the expected loss is 96 s per A trip.
routes.dominant: wait for the F at 4 Av-9 St
